title: Nan Nyang Geubri Sigohlom Lahe .
intro: Bayangkan saboh teumpat suci nyang seungap nyang peunoh ngon doá nyang sunggoh-sunggoh lheueh meuthon-thon treb geupreh. Dari hai-hai nyang hana deuh teuka saboh jaweueb nyang jiba nan nyang gohlom tom geubri sigohlom jih, nyang meujanji hikmah nibak thon-thon awai dan udeb nyang geutanda ngon bakti, belas kasihan, dan keusucian.
clues: Lon ka geuboh nan le Allah keudroe sigohlom lon lahe, deungon nan nyang hana tom geubri keu soe mantong sigohlom lon.
Lon geubri seubagoe jawaban ateuh doa yang sunggoh-sunggoh le ureung tuha yang geukira keturunan nyan dilua kemungkenan.
Ulôn geubri keubijaksanaan, huköman dan Alkitab bak watée ulôn mantong muda.
Lon na tugaih keu ureung chik lon dan lon weueh hate keu gob, dan lon hana sombong atawa hana ta’at.
Allah neupeuteuntèë damé ateuëh ulôn bak uroë ulôn lahé, uroë ulôn maté, dan uroë ulôn beudjeuët hudép.
Ayah lon Zakariyya geuteurimong haba seunang nibak lon dari malaikat watee geudong seumayang di teumpat suci (mihrab).

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌۭ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌۭ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
verse: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when I have reached old age and my wife is barren?" He [the angel] said, "Such is Allāh; He does what He wills." (3:40)
